title: Last Moment Before All Ants Fall Out Of A Plank
statement:
A plank has length `n`. Ants move at one unit per second toward either end and fall off immediately on arrival. When two ants meet, they reverse direction; this is equivalent to the ants passing through each other. Given the starting positions moving left and right, return the time when the last ant falls.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 4, left = [4,3], right = [0,1]
Output: 4
```

```text
Input: n = 7, left = [], right = [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]
Output: 7
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 10^4`
- Every position is in `[0,n]`, and positions across both arrays are unique
- At least one and at most `n + 1` ants are present
